note: Per-layer escalator series for layer_index_model.py (research pass 3 Oct 2026). As of the 3 Oct 2026 afternoon build the BLS series (transformer, switchgear, engineering, eci_construction, construction_inputs, electrical_equipment) are overridden by indices_layers_api.json, pulled from the FRED and BLS APIs by fetch_indices.py; the values below are the earlier search-excerpt set kept for traceability. Values 2014-2023 for the BLS PPI series are exact FRED observations from a public mirror (annual averages); 2024-2026 are annual anchors from search excerpts of FRED/BLS pages (Medium) or held at the last anchor. Direct access to fred.stlouisfed.org, bls.gov, enr.com and pjm.com is blocked from this environment; fetch_indices.py replaces these values from the FRED/BLS APIs once the hosts are allowed. The model interpolates linearly between points and holds flat outside the span. Verify at source before external use.

composition_developer.note: Merchant 4-h project structure. Shares are an analyst assumption bracketed by the NREL ATB bottom-up structure (pack, PCS, structural and electrical BOS, labor, EPC and developer overhead, interconnection allowance; line values not retrievable this pass), the IRS Notice 2026-15 safe-harbor table (cells = 52% of BESS equipment cost) and ESS News (Apr 2026: cells 25-45% of project capex). Confidence Medium-Low; sensitivity on the battery share is on slides 15 and 18.

transformer.label: PPI commodity: power and distribution transformers, except parts (WPU117409, Dec 1999 = 100), annual average
transformer.source: FRED mirror of BLS series (open-datahub/commodity, obs. to Oct 2023); 2025-26 from WPU11740999 anchors (Sep 2025 351.2, Nov 2025 365.1, Jan 2026 366.6) divided by the 1.01 ratio between the two series

switchgear.label: PPI commodity: switchgear, switchboard, industrial controls equipment (WPU1175, 1982 = 100), annual average
switchgear.source: FRED mirror of BLS series (obs. to Nov 2023); Aug 2025 384.1 and Jul 2026 419.3 from search excerpts of the FRED page

engineering.label: PPI commodity: engineering services (WPU4532, Mar 2009 = 100), annual average
engineering.source: FRED mirror of BLS series (obs. to Nov 2023); 2025-26 extended at the industry index's primary-services growth (PCU541330541330P 159.3 Mar 2015 to 207.5 Feb 2025, about 3%/yr)

labor.label: IBEW Local 103 (Boston) journeyman inside wireman base rate, $/h, Sep or Mar of year
labor.source: MA DLS prevailing-wage schedules (2018, 2020), Boston JATC rate sheets (2022-2025), CBA 2023-2026 via secondary sites (2026); 2015-2017 back-cast at the 2018-2022 rate of 3.2%/yr

civil.label: ENR Construction Cost Index, 20-city average (1913 = 100), annual average
civil.source: MWD reproduction of the ENR table (2017), prior-pass log (2018), City of San Francisco AICCIE proposal (2023, 2024), ENR 2025 monthly points (Jan 13,732; Jun 13,871; Sep 13,928; 2025 = mean of the three); 2026 held at Sep 2025
civil.conf: Medium 2017-2018 and 2023-2024; Medium-Low 2025; 2019-2022 interpolated (ENR Dec-over-Dec changes 2022 +5.6%, 2023 +2.6%, 2024 +0.9%, 2025 +3.6% as cross-check)

eci_construction.label: BLS Employment Cost Index, total compensation, private industry, construction (CIU2012300000000I, Dec 2005 = 100), December (alternative labor series, not used in the composite)

eci_construction.conf: Medium at the quoted points; gaps interpolated

hw_dist_station.label: Handy-Whitman North Atlantic, distribution station equipment (acct 362), July (1973 = 100); alternative for layer D

hw_line_transformers.label: Handy-Whitman North Atlantic, distribution line transformers (acct 368), July (1973 = 100); cross-check for layer C

context.lithium_carbonate: USGS annual average US price $/t: 2018 16,000; 2019 13,000; 2020 8,400; 2021 12,600; 2022 37,000; 2024 14,000; 2025 9,000 (Medium). China spot CNY/t: end-2024 75,050; end-2025 117,000-125,000; 2026 Jan-May monthly 149,000-184,000; Sep 2026 119,000-158,000 (Medium). Not used as an escalator: cells are 25-45% of project capex and the series is too volatile.
context.anza: Anza Renewables delivered-equipment price, $/kWh: utility self-integrated DC $177 (May 2025 peak), $154 (Nov 2025), $145 (Feb 2026); distribution-scale AC $203 and DC $175 (Feb 2026); Q2 2025 report: utility AC +56% Jan to May 2025 on tariffs (Medium).
context.woodmac: Wood Mackenzie utility-scale system price $/kW: Q4 2024 1,050; Q4 2025 938; Q2 2026 916 (Medium).
context.tariffs_feoc: China-origin non-EV Li-ion cells: 3.4% MFN + 25% Section 301 (from 1 Jan 2026) + reported 12.5% Section 301 forced-labor action (from 24 Jul 2026), about 41% (Low-Medium on the July action); IEEPA tariffs struck down 20 Feb 2026; no AD/CVD on anode material (ITC negative, 12 Mar 2026). IRS Notice 2026-15 (12 Feb 2026): material-assistance cost ratio for energy storage by construction-start year 2026 55%, 2027 60%, 2028 65%, 2029 70%, 2030+ 75%; failure disallows the whole 48E credit; safe-harbor table puts cells at 52% of BESS equipment cost (High on dates and thresholds).
